frozen_note: written on 2026-10-25 after nba-live14-1.0 rejected the extended dataset as a whole (play-in and playoffs in the history made rebounds and assists worse) and before any number of this variant existed. The variant keeps the regular-season history of RUN071 and only adds the new box-score columns
question: Does adding the new box-score columns to the RUN071 regular-season rows (turnovers, field-goal and free-throw attempts, offensive rebounds) and the estimated possessions to its games improve the deployed live 1.4.0 model, by giving values to pace_c, opp_def_c and usage_trend (constant 0 today) and by making player_turnovers possible?

data.players: RUN071 players.jsonl.gz with tov, fga, fta, oreb copied from nba_extended_box_20261024 for the same (game, player, team); a row whose game is missing there keeps None for those four
data.games: RUN071 games.json with possessions_estimate of each side copied from the extended games for the same game id; missing games keep None
data.checks: every copied row must agree with RUN071 on points, rebounds, assists, threes, steals and blocks, otherwise the build stops; no row, game or season type is added or removed

validation.reference: the deployed 1.4.0 configuration: RUN071, old + T-60 reports, BASE + ENV features, 11 player markets
validation.candidate: the same configuration on the RUN071 + columns data
validation.fit: nba.multimarket_v13_live.fit_model as if the target were 2025-26 (2023-24 and 2024-25)
validation.units: 2025-26 regular-season player-games at the reference grid, each arm pricing them with its own history (identical for both: only the four columns differ)
validation.bootstrap: paired differences resampled by whole dates, 400 replicates, seed 20261030

acceptance.data: accepted if the pooled Brier difference over the 11 player markets has a 95% upper bound below 0 AND no single market is worse with a lower bound above 0 at 99.55% (Bonferroni over 11). The team model does not read the new columns and is not compared
acceptance.turnovers: player_turnovers enters only if the data is accepted and its live calibration beats the raw law with the upper bound of the 99% interval below 0, slope in [0.9, 1.1] and |intercept| <= 0.10

deployment_rule: if accepted, the server's data folder is replaced by the RUN071 + columns files (the old ones kept for rollback) together with a model fitted on them; otherwise nothing changes
limits: the 53 regular-season games that the extended dataset quarantined keep no columns, so the history of a few players has gaps there
